result.stdout:
cosmokv — admin CLI for CosmoKv databases.

Subcommands:
  info       <dir>                                       Print level layout + read-ts.
  dump       <dir>  [--prefix P] [--all-versions]        Newline-delimited KVs.
  get        <dir>  <key>                                Point lookup.
  set        <dir>  <key> <value>                        Auto-commit single set.
  gc         <dir>                                       Run one vlog-GC pass.
  sweep-ttl  <dir>                                       Tombstone expired keys.
  flush      <dir>                                       Force-flush memtables to SST.
  backup     <dir>  <out.bak>                            Export to COSMOBAK stream.
  restore    <in.bak>  <target-dir>                      Import a COSMOBAK stream.

Common flags:
  --key <hex32>     32-byte master key (hex) for encrypted databases.
  --hex-key         Interpret <key> as hex bytes (default UTF-8).
  --hex-value       Interpret <value> as hex bytes (default UTF-8).

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 missing args, 2 error, 3 not found (get).
